plainText:
Alejandro Saab is an American actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Saab was born on November 15, 1994, in Dallas, Texas. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons. Saab joined the during , where he voiced recurring character . He is also a well known YouTube Personality and Twitch Streamer.
